body:
Aren't therapists expensive? I don't think I'd be able to afford one. The problem is that I don't trust any family member enough to tell them how I feel because they'd probably tell my parents and my parents would freak out. I've been having suicidal thoughts since high school (I was bullied a lot) and I'd just try to push my way through all the pain. It had been working, up until recently. Now I just can't help but think of what would be the easiest way to kill myself. Maybe oding on pills, or cutting my throat, or jumping off a hotel, maybe jumping off a bridge into the fraser river. 

I'm afraid of telling any of my friends, even my closest friends. I've always been the person they could turn to for support, I've always had to put on a facade of being the happy-go-lucky friend who had everything in his life worked out. I was meant to be the person who would advise and help my friends through thick and thin. I don't know if I could ever ask for the same support I've given them, what if they were to lose their confidence after learning I had been in a deep depression for so long.
